name: Mini Photo Editor
tagline: Crop, rotate and filter a photo on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Open a picture from this computer. Drag on it to crop. Rotate left or right. Pick a look — Vintage, Polaroid, Kodak, Browni — or stay with the original. Bright, contrast, sat, warmth and vignette sit underneath. Download keeps a JPEG here.

This is not a drawing app and not a compressor. It is the crop / rotate / filter loop.

The last recipe you left stays on this device. The photo itself stays in memory until you open another.

Want a friend using the same recipe? Press Play together, then Invite (in the GifOS menu). They get your sliders and look, not your photo.

An unofficial port of mini-photo-editor.
